verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents first-party prompt management: the API and SDKs can "manage prompts", prompts can be authored via MCP, and Playgrounds offer a no-code workspace for iterating on prompts. Nothing in the pack shows prompt version history or a way to push prompt changes to production without a code deploy. The versioning evidence covers datasets only and does not carry over to prompts. missing for 10: documented prompt versioning/history, a mechanism for deploying or promoting prompt versions to production without code changes (e.g. runtime prompt fetching or environments), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can version prompts and deploy changes to production without shipping code

citations.quote: Log traces, manage prompts, create datasets, and run evals or experiments right from your code.
Playgrounds provide a no-code workspace for rapidly iterating on prompts, models, scorers, and datasets.
Query production logs, author prompts and scorers, configure monitoring, and run evals
